title: Incorporating Continuous Dependence Qualifies Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Operator Learning
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have been proven as a promising way for solving various partial differential equations, especially high-dimensional ones and those with irregular boundaries. However, their capabilities in real applications are highly restricted by their poor generalization performance.
